steps.operation: Download the eight pinned files into a disposable owner-controlled staging directory; persist the upstream Apache license and notices outside the exact snapshot. Hugging Face may place .cache/huggingface metadata beside downloaded files. Reject partial files and the -it repository.
steps.gate: Before download, verify enough free disk for 23,919,549,408 source bytes plus cache/temp overhead; the current 20 GB free workspace fails. Then confirm all eight named files exist as regular files in staging. No private person data or paid GPU is required. Keep metadata cache and partial files outside snapshot_dir.

steps.operation: On the same filesystem, create a fresh empty snapshot directory and move only the eight manifest-named regular files into it. Do not move the Hugging Face .cache/huggingface directory, temporary files or a license copy into the exact snapshot.
steps.gate: Exactly eight regular, nonsymlink files and no nested metadata directory are in snapshot_dir. Any partial move must fail the following exact-tree verifier and be discarded.

steps.operation: Rehash all eight files against the pinned independent manifest and emit a fresh path-specific receipt.
steps.gate: All file sizes and SHA-256 digests match; a historical receipt alone does not pass.

steps.operation: Inventory BF16 tensor names, shapes and offsets without assigning behavior to a tensor based on its name.
steps.gate: Source digest and config agree; the inventory is structural evidence only.

steps.operation: Emit the existing seven public synthetic inputs and freeze the emitted prompt bytes before model runs.
steps.gate: No private Elaina, Rayan or consumer payload; record prompt digest and fixture/source revisions. This diagnostic is not FINAL gold.

steps.operation: Run deterministic offline inference against the unmodified exact source and capture raw and displayed outputs. Check actual fit on the available GPU.
steps.gate: Real model outputs, runtime/device receipt and unexercised modality coverage are recorded. Never substitute a stub or the -it trainer.

steps.operation: Create an MFM role-local immutable clone of the freshly verified source, preserving Google ancestry. Record parent and clone hashes; this is still pristine upstream behavior.
steps.gate: Fresh clone path and external receipt, exact eight-file digest, separate storage capacity; a clone is not a prepared base or measured suppression.

steps.operation: Localize an observed unwanted behavior with a controlled intervention and independently produce an explicitly justified replacement tensor. The staging CLI streams exactly one named same-shape payload after checking old/new SHA-256 and size. It does not choose, generate, or validate the efficacy of that payload.
steps.implementation_status: Manifest-checked staging and sealed stage receipt implemented with tiny synthetic tests. No real replacement payload, 24 GB intervention, causal localization or behavior result exists.
steps.gate: The parent clone and payload are authenticated; capture the staging tool's candidate_weight_sha256 and old/new tensor hashes as a durable receipt. Candidate remains staged_unqualified. No candidate should be promoted on a tensor name, token marker, or speculative edit alone.

steps.operation: Make a separately hash-linked MFM derivative from the staged candidate, verify changed weight bytes and publisher notices, and retain immutable parent and rollback. Bind the derivative's file digest to the captured staging output before asserting this was the one-tensor candidate. Derivative custody is not a behavior pass.
steps.implementation_status: Custody and integrity tooling has tiny synthetic tests only. No actual prepared Gemma derivative exists.
steps.gate: Fresh derivative receipt binds the stage receipt, operation digest, exact candidate weight hash and exclusive named-tensor diff. The artifact remains behaviorally unqualified until paired tests; receipt hashes are local integrity evidence, not signatures.

steps.operation: Run matched untouched and prepared-base diagnostics, independently check the targeted inherited behavior, general competence and cross-role regressions, and either retain or reject the candidate with a causal receipt.
steps.implementation_status: Prepared runner and seven-case scorer have CPU fixture tests. No real 12B paired inference or independent broad behavior qualification has run. The diagnostic alone cannot promote a base.
steps.gate: A real public paired diagnostic is required, followed by independent targeted behavior and competence cases. If either fails or lacks coverage, specialist training is blocked and the derivative remains unqualified.

steps.operation: Initialize and train separate MFM formation-specific parameters with a source-selection, subject/time, uncertainty, consolidation, correction and deletion objective. Bind proposals to registered evidence and a deterministic canonical Claim gate. Isolate per-user data, gradients, adapters and memory.
steps.synthetic_training_argument_alternative: For training-only runs, replace --admitted-manifest {admitted_manifest} in all four tools with --curriculum-manifest {training_curriculum_manifest} --owner-authorization-ref {owner_authorization_ref}; bind input_sha256 to that curriculum manifest. This does not supply development or FINAL gold.
steps.implementation_status: V1 specialist trainer and CPU tests exist. No exact 12B processor pass, BF16 backward/probe, full fit, independent FINAL or role qualification has run. Configurable source/target budgets and decoder size are admission choices, not a proven capability ceiling.
steps.gate: Run admitted private data only in an OS-enforced no-egress process; data and CPU processor preflights pass on exact artifacts; measure complete backward, checkpoint/restart and full envelope before paying for full fit. Formation weights have independent first-party lineage and causal contribution; a personal-data fine-tuned chatbot is insufficient.

steps.operation: Compare source-only, edited-base, fine-tuned-base control, specialist removal/swap, and full governed memory loop on independent histories. Exercise cross-person attribution, correction/deletion, uncertainty, multimodal cases and no-egress private custody.
steps.gate: Critical authority/privacy failures are zero on the qualified suite and the specialist has causal value; no finite test certifies universal zero foreign influence.
